СОБРАНИЕ НА РЕПУБЛИКА СЕВЕРНА МАКЕДОНИЈА

Врз основа на членот 75, ставови 1 и 2 од Уставот на Република Северна Македонија, претседателот на Република Северна Македонија и претседателот на Собранието на Република Северна Македонија издаваат
У К А З

ЗА СПРЕЧУВАЊЕ И ЗАШТИТА ОД НАСИЛСТВО ВРЗ ЖЕНИТЕ И СЕМЕЈНОТО НАСИЛСТВО

I.	ОПШТИ ОДРЕДБИ

Предмет на законот

## Член 1

Со овој закон се уредува постапувањето на институциите со должно внимание при преземањето на мерки за превенција од родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство, постапувањето на институциите за заштита на жените од родово- базирано насилство и семејното насилство, меѓусебната координација на институциите и организациите, услугите за заштита на жртвите и собирањето на податоци за родово- базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство.

Цел на законот

## Член 2

Цел на законот е превенција и спречување на родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство, ефективна заштита на жртвите од каков било облик на родово- базирано насилство врз жени како и на жртвите на семејно насилство со почитување на основните човекови слободи и права загарантирани со Уставот на Република Северна Македонија и меѓународните договори ратификувани во согласност со Уставот на

Република Северна Македонија (во натамошниот текст: ратификуваните меѓународни договори). Целта на законот се заснова на принципот на еднаквост и елиминирање на стeреотипите за родовите улоги.

ASSEMBLY OF THE REPUBLIC OF NORTH MACEDONIA

Pursuant to Article 75, paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Constitution of the Republic of North Macedonia, the President of the Republic of North Macedonia and the President of the Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia issue

L A W
ON PREVENTION AND PROTECTION FROM VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN AND DOMESTIC VIOLENCE

I.	GENERAL PROVISIONS

Subject of the law

## Article 1

This law regulates the conduct of institutions with due diligence in taking measures for prevention of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, the conduct of institutions for protection of women from gender-based violence and domestic violence, mutual coordination of institutions and organizations, services for protection of victims and collection of data on gender-based violence against women and domestic violence.

Purpose of the law

## Article 2

The purpose of the law is prevention and suppression of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, effective protection of victims from any form of gender-based violence against women as well as victims of domestic violence with respect for fundamental human freedoms and rights guaranteed by the Constitution of the Republic of North Macedonia and international treaties ratified in accordance with the Constitution of the

Republic of North Macedonia (hereinafter: ratified international treaties). The purpose of the law is based on the principle of equality and elimination of stereotypes about gender roles.

## Член 4

(1)	Органите на државната власт, правните лица кои вршат јавни овластувања утврдени со закон, функционерите, службениците и другите овластени лица кои извршуваат работи во име на државата имаат обврска да се воздржат од учество во дејствие на насилство и да ги преземат сите мерки и активности за да спречат какво било дејствие на родово- базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство.
(2)	Субјектите од ставот (1) на овој член имаат обврска да ги преземат сите соодветни законодавни, управни, судски и други мерки за да превенираат, да заштитат, да истражат, казнат и да обезбедат правичен надоместок на жртвите или враќање во првобитна положба за дејствијата на насилство што се извршени од физички или правни лица.
(3)	Службените лица во институциите кои вршат дејност од областа на социјалната заштита, внатрешните работи, здравството, детската заштита и образованието, како и надлежните судови и обвинителства во постапките за родово- базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство се должни да постапуваат итно, со должно внимание на интересите и потребите на жртвата.

II.	ОСНОВНИ НАЧЕЛА

Недискриминација

## Член 5

(1)	Родово-базираното насилство врз жените е дискриминација врз жените што ги ограничува да ги уживаат правата и слободите на еднаква основа со мажите.
(2)	Мерките, активностите и услугите од овој закон се преземаат со цел спроведување на принципот на еднаквост, елиминирање на стереотипите за родовите улоги, превенција и заштита од сите форми на дискриминација врз жените жртви на родово-базирано насилство и жртвите на семејно насилство.
(3)	Мерките, активностите и услугите за превенција и заштита на жените од родово- базирано насилство и жртвите на семејното насилство се спроведуваат без дискриминација врз основа на раса, боја на кожа, потекло национална или етничка припадност, пол, род, сексуална ориентација, родов идентитет, припадност на маргинализирана група, јазик, државјанство, социјално потекло, образование, религија или верско уверување, политичко уверување, друго уверување, попреченост, возраст, семејна или брачна состојба, имотен статус, здравствена состојба, лично својство и општествен статус или која било друга основа.
(4)	Mерките, активности и услугите од овој закон, кои се преземаат за спречување и заштита на жените од родово-базирано насилство и семејно насилство не се сметаат за дискриминација.

Забрана од виктимизација

## Член 6

Се забранува секое дејствие кое се презема со цел намерно или ненамерно да се казни или стави во понеповолна положба лице кое преземало дејствија за заштита од родово- базирано насилство и семејно насилство, односно доколку лицето пријавило насилство, почнало постапка за заштита од родово-базирано насилство и семејно насилство, сведочело во текот на постапката или на друг начин учествувало во постапка за заштита од родово-базирано насилство и семејно насилство.

Ранливи жени

## Член 7

Субјектите од членовите 11 и 24 од овој закон се должни при преземањето на мерки и активности да ги имаат предвид последиците што родово-базираното насилство го има врз ранливите категории жени, посебно врз бремените жени, жени со деца и деца со попреченост, самохрани мајки, жени со попреченост, жени од рурални средини, жени кои употребуваат дроги, сексуални работнички, мигрантки, бегалки, барателки на азил, жени без државјанство, лезбијки, бисексуалки и трансродови луѓе, жени кои живеат со ХИВ, бездомнички, жени жртви на трговија со луѓе, повозрасни жени, материјално необезбедени жени и други.

Соодветно приспособување

## Член 8

Мерките, активностите и услугите за жртвите на родово-базираното насилство врз жените и семејното насилство, треба да се соодветно приспособени на специфичните потреби на жените со попреченост.
Начело на родово одговорни политики

## Член 9

(1)	Мерките, активностите и услугите за превенција и заштита на жените од родово- базирано насилство и семејното насилство, треба да бидат родово одговорни и да ги препознаваат карактеристиките и разликите кои произлегуваат од родовите улоги на жените и мажите, за да може резултатите на мерките, активностите и услугите да придонесат за родова еднаквост.
(2)	Родово одговорните политики ја вклучуваат родовата перспектива како критериум кој е интегриран во сите фази од процесот на креирање на политиките, оценката на состојбите, имплементацијата и евалуацијата на политиките кои произлегуваат од овој закон.

Начело на зајакнување на жените кои трпат насилство

## Член 10

(1)	Мерките, активностите и услугите за превенција и заштита на жените од родово- базирано насилство и од семејно насилство, се обезбедуваат на начин кој овозможува зајакнување на потенцијалот и капацитетите на жртвата за независно организирање на живот и само-помош во иднина.

(2)	Жртвата има право да учествува во проценката на нејзината состојба и потреби, да биде информирана за мерките, активностите и услугите за заштита и да учествува во изборот на услугите и мерките за нејзина помош, поддршка и заштита.
(3)	Без согласност на жртвата, односно нејзиниот законски застапник не може да се преземат мерки, активности и услуги за заштита, освен кога постои непосредна опасност по нејзиниот живот и тело.

III.	НАДЛЕЖНИ ИНСТИТУЦИИ И ИНТЕГРИРАНИ ПОЛИТИКИ

Надлежност за спроведување на законот

## Член 11

(1)	Надлежни за спроведување на овој закон се сите органи на државната управа, судовите, јавното обвинителство, единиците на локална самоуправа и правните лица кои вршат јавни овластувања утврдени со закон.
(2)	Субјектите од ставот (1) на овој член се должни да обезбедат работите од својата надлежност да ја вршат стручни лица, обучени за спроведување на работите определени со овој закон.

Институционална и мултисекторска соработка

## Член 12

(1)	Субјектите од членот 11 од овој закон се должни меѓусебно да соработуваат за остварување на целите од овој закон со изготвување на протокол за меѓусебна соработка.
(2)	Единиците на локалната самоуправа со институциите и здруженијата, изготвуваат протокол за меѓусебна соработка за преземање на мерки за превенција, спречување и заштита од родово-базирано насилство врз жени и семејно насилство во локалната заедница.

Собрание на Република Северна Македонија

## Член 13

(1)	Собранието на Република Северна Македонија, на предлог на Владата на Република Северна Македонија, донесува Национална стратегија за превенција и заштита од родово- базирано насилство врз жени и семејно насилство (во натамошниот текст: Стратегијата).
(2)	Стратегијата се донесува за период од осум години, а се спроведува преку два национални акциски планови во траење од по четири години и годишни оперативни планови на ниво на надлежните институции.
(3)	Собранието го следи спроведувањето на Стратегијата и на трошењето на средствата од Буџетот од годишните оперативни планови преку годишниот извештај на Националното координативно тело од членот 15 од овој закон.

Влада на Република Северна Македонија

## Член 14

Владата на Република Северна Македонија (во натамошниот текст: Владата), во рамките на своите надлежности презема мерки и активности за превенција и заштита на родово-базираното насилство врз жените и семејното насилство преку вклучување на принципот на еднаквост и елиминирање на стереотипите за родовите улоги во предлозите

на законите и другите прописи, организирање и финансирање на национални кампањи за подигање на свеста за сите форми на родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство и друго.
Национално координативно тело за имплементација на Конвенцијата на Советот на Европа за спречување и борба против насилството врз жените и семејно насилство

## Article 4

(1) The state authorities, legal entities exercising public powers established by law, officials, civil servants and other authorized persons performing work on behalf of the state have an obligation to refrain from participating in acts of violence and to take all measures and activities to prevent any act of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence.
(2) The subjects from paragraph (1) of this article have an obligation to take all appropriate legislative, administrative, judicial and other measures to prevent, protect, investigate, punish and provide fair compensation to victims or restoration to their original position for acts of violence committed by natural or legal persons.
(3) Officials in institutions performing activities in the field of social protection, internal affairs, health, child protection and education, as well as the competent courts and public prosecutor's offices in proceedings for gender-based violence against women and domestic violence are obliged to act urgently, with due regard to the interests and needs of the victim.

II. BASIC PRINCIPLES

Non-discrimination

## Article 5

(1) Gender-based violence against women is discrimination against women that restricts them from enjoying rights and freedoms on an equal basis with men.
(2) The measures, activities and services under this law are undertaken with the aim of implementing the principle of equality, eliminating stereotypes about gender roles, prevention and protection from all forms of discrimination against women victims of gender-based violence and victims of domestic violence.
(3) The measures, activities and services for prevention and protection of women from gender-based violence and victims of domestic violence are implemented without discrimination on the basis of race, skin color, origin, national or ethnic affiliation, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, membership in a marginalized group, language, citizenship, social origin, education, religion or religious belief, political belief, other belief, disability, age, family or marital status, property status, health condition, personal characteristic and social status or any other basis.
(4) The measures, activities and services under this law, which are undertaken for prevention and protection of women from gender-based violence and domestic violence are not considered discrimination.

Prohibition of victimization

## Article 6

Any action taken with the aim of intentionally or unintentionally punishing or placing in a less favorable position a person who has taken actions for protection from gender-based violence and domestic violence is prohibited, that is, if the person has reported violence, initiated proceedings for protection from gender-based violence and domestic violence, testified during the proceedings or otherwise participated in proceedings for protection from gender-based violence and domestic violence.

Vulnerable women

## Article 7

The subjects from Articles 11 and 24 of this law are obliged when undertaking measures and activities to take into account the consequences that gender-based violence has on vulnerable categories of women, especially on pregnant women, women with children and children with disabilities, single mothers, women with disabilities, women from rural areas, women who use drugs, sex workers, migrants, refugees, asylum seekers, stateless women, lesbians, bisexuals and transgender people, women living with HIV, homeless women, women victims of human trafficking, elderly women, materially insecure women and others.

Reasonable accommodation

## Article 8

The measures, activities and services for victims of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence should be reasonably accommodated to the specific needs of women with disabilities.
Principle of gender-responsive policies

## Article 9

(1) The measures, activities and services for prevention and protection of women from gender-based violence and domestic violence should be gender-responsive and recognize the characteristics and differences arising from the gender roles of women and men, so that the results of the measures, activities and services contribute to gender equality.
(2) Gender-responsive policies include the gender perspective as a criterion that is integrated in all phases of the policy-making process, assessment of situations, implementation and evaluation of policies arising from this law.

Principle of empowerment of women who suffer violence

## Article 10

(1) The measures, activities and services for prevention and protection of women from gender-based violence and from domestic violence are provided in a manner that enables strengthening of the potential and capacities of the victim for independent organization of life and self-help in the future.

(2) The victim has the right to participate in the assessment of her condition and needs, to be informed about the measures, activities and services for protection and to participate in the selection of services and measures for her assistance, support and protection.
(3) Without the consent of the victim, that is, her legal representative, measures, activities and services for protection cannot be undertaken, except when there is immediate danger to her life and body.

III. COMPETENT INSTITUTIONS AND INTEGRATED POLICIES

Competence for implementation of the law

## Article 11

(1) Competent for implementation of this law are all state administration bodies, courts, public prosecutor's office, local self-government units and legal entities exercising public powers established by law.
(2) The subjects from paragraph (1) of this article are obliged to ensure that the work within their competence is performed by professional persons trained for implementation of the work specified by this law.

Institutional and multisectoral cooperation

## Article 12

(1) The subjects from Article 11 of this law are obliged to cooperate with each other for achieving the objectives of this law by preparing a protocol for mutual cooperation.
(2) The local self-government units with institutions and associations prepare a protocol for mutual cooperation for undertaking measures for prevention, suppression and protection from gender-based violence against women and domestic violence in the local community.

Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia

## Article 13

(1) The Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia, on the proposal of the Government of the Republic of North Macedonia, adopts a National Strategy for Prevention and Protection from Gender-Based Violence against Women and Domestic Violence (hereinafter: the Strategy).
(2) The Strategy is adopted for a period of eight years, and is implemented through two national action plans lasting four years each and annual operational plans at the level of the competent institutions.
(3) The Assembly monitors the implementation of the Strategy and the spending of funds from the Budget from the annual operational plans through the annual report of the National Coordinating Body from Article 15 of this law.

Government of the Republic of North Macedonia

## Article 14

The Government of the Republic of North Macedonia (hereinafter: the Government), within its competences, undertakes measures and activities for prevention and protection from gender-based violence against women and domestic violence through inclusion of the principle of equality and elimination of stereotypes about gender roles in draft

laws and other regulations, organizing and financing national campaigns to raise awareness about all forms of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence and other.

## Член 28

(1)	Субјектите од членовите 11 и 24 од овој закон, прибираат статистички и административни податоци за состојбата со родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство, врз основа на пол, род, возраст, припадност на заедница, живеалиште и други податоци утврдени со овој или друг закон, согласно со одредбите од Законот за заштита на личните податоци.
(2)	Министерството за труд и социјална политика на дневна основа користејќи ја националната платформа за интероперабилност – Македонска информациска магистрала (во натамошниот текст: МИМ), ги презема податоците од субјектите определени со ставот
(1) на овој член кои се корисници на МИМ, согласно со прописите од областа на електронското управување и електронските услуги.

(3)	Субјектите од ставот (1) на овој член кои не корисници на МИМ и немаат можност за непосредна размена на податоци преку МИМ се должни да развијат веб- сервиси на соодветна платформа која ги исполнува условите определени со прописите од областа на електронското управување и електронските услуги, во кои ќе се содржат бараните податоци од Министерството за труд и социјална политика.
(4)	Министерството за труд и социјална политика, користејќи ги претходно собраните податоци од субјектите од ставот (1) на овој член, извршува анализа и статистичка обработка на истите во својот систем за социјални права и услуги. Анализите и извештаите во кои нема податоци кои се заштитени со Законот за заштита на личните податоци, Министерството за труд и социјална политика ги објавува на годишно ниво во форма и содржина што ја утврдува министерот за труд и социјална политика.
(5)	Податоците од ставот (1) на овој член кои не содржат лични податоци, надлежните институции се должни во обработена форма јавно да ги објават на своите веб-страници, како и во Централниот каталог на податоци од јавниот сектор согласно со Законот за користење на податоците од јавниот сектор.
(6)	Формата, содржината и начинот на интегрирано прибирање на податоците од ставот
(1)	на овој член, внесувањето на податоците во системот за социјална права и услуги од ставот (4) на овој член и содржината на податоците од ставот (5) на овој член, ги пропишува министерот за труд и социјална политика во согласност со министерот за внатрешни работи, министерот за здравство и министерот за правда.

Судови

## Член 29

(1)	Судовите воспоставуваат и водат посебна евиденција за бројот на случаи на родово- базирано насилство врз жените и жртвите на семејното насилство врз основа на пол, род, возраст, етничка припадност, попреченост, живеалиште и други основи, како и податоци релевантни за следење на состојбата со родово-базираното насилство врз жените и семејното насилство, согласно со закон.
(2)	Содржината и начинот на прибирање на податоците од ставот (1) на овој член ги пропишува министерот за правда.

Јавно обвинителство

## Член 30

(1)	Јавните обвинителства воспоставуваат и водат посебна евиденција за предмети на родово-базирано насилство врз жените и жртвите на семејното насилство врз основа на пол, род, возраст, етничка припадност, попреченост, живеалиште и други основи, како и податоци релевантни за следење на состојбата со родово-базираното насилство врз жените и семејното насилство согласно со закон.
(2)	Содржината и начинот на прибирање на податоците од ставот (1) на овој член ги пропишува министерот за правда.

Национално истражување

## Член 31

(1)	Државниот завод за статистика спроведува национално истражување за состојбата со родово-базираното насилство врз жените и семејното насилство.

(2)	Истражувањето има за цел да обезбеди сеопфатни информации за бројот на случаи на одделните форми на родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство според пол, род, возраст, етничка припадност, попреченост, географска припадност на жртвата и сторителот и други информации релевантни за следење на состојбата за насилство врз жените.

Заштита на личните податоци

## Член 32

(1)	Субјектите од членовите 11 и 24 од овој закон, собираат, обработуваат, користат, чуваат и бришат лични податоци согласно со Законот за заштита на личните податоци.
(2)	Личните податоци собрани согласно овој закон, веднаш се бришат во случаите кога ќе се утврди дека не се точни или престанале причините, односно условите заради кои личниот податок е внесен во евиденцијата.
(3)	Личните податоци собрани согласно со овој закон, сé до нивното бришење, смеат да се даваат под услови утврдени со Законот за заштита на личните податоци.
(4)	Правото на субјектот на лични податоци на пристап и исправка на лични податоци со кои располагаат субјектите од членовите 11 и 24 од овој закон, како и обврската за заштита на личните податоци се обезбедуваат под услови утврдени со Законот за заштита на личните податоци.
(5)	Субјектите од членовите 11 и 24 од овој закон се должни да обезбедат тајност и заштита на обработката на личните податоци на субјектот на лични податоци, при што мора да применат соодветни технички и организациски мерки за заштита од случајно или незаконско уништување на личните податоци или нивно случајно губење, преправање, неовластено откривање или пристап, особено кога обработката вклучува пренос на податоци преку мрежа и заштита од какви било незаконски облици на обработка.
V.	ПРЕВЕНЦИЈА ОД РОДОВО-БАЗИРАНО НАСИЛСТВО ВРЗ ЖЕНИ И СЕМЕЈНО НАСИЛСТВО

## Член 33

(1)	Oрганите на државната управа, единиците на локалната самоуправа,

(2)	Механизмите за родова еднаквост во органите на државната управа и во единиците на локалната самоуправа определени со закон, вршат координација и даваат иницијатива за преземање на превентивни мерки согласно со овој закон.

Општи превентивни мерки

## Член 34

Субјектите од членот 33 од овој закон ги преземаат следниве општи превентивни мерки:
1)	донесуваат програма за планирање и имплементирање на превентивни мерки и активности согласно со овој закон;

2)	спроведуваат кампањи за препознавање на последиците од родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство;
3)	воспоставуваат систем за редовно објавување на информации за мерки за безбедност, совети и други корисни информации за превенција од насилство и
4)	меѓусебно соработуваат во промоција и превенција од родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејното насилство.

Courts

## Article 29

(1) The courts establish and maintain a special record of the number of cases of gender-based violence against women and victims of domestic violence based on sex, gender, age, ethnicity, disability, place of residence and other grounds, as well as data relevant for monitoring the situation of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, in accordance with law.

Public Prosecution

## Article 30

(1) The public prosecution offices establish and maintain a special record of cases of gender-based violence against women and victims of domestic violence based on sex, gender, age, ethnicity, disability, place of residence and other grounds, as well as data relevant for monitoring the situation of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence in accordance with law.
(2) The content and manner of collecting data from paragraph (1) of this article are prescribed by the Minister of Justice.

National Survey

## Article 31

(1) The State Statistical Office conducts a national survey on the situation of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence.

## Article 32

V. PREVENTION OF GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN AND DOMESTIC VIOLENCE

## Article 33

(1) The state administration bodies, local self-government units, the public and private sector, political parties, the media, associations and foundations, informal groups, social partners, trade unions, religious organisations and other organisations are obliged to undertake preventive measures to raise awareness of all forms of gender-based violence, promote gender equality and eliminate stereotypes about gender roles based on culture, customs, religion, traditions and other practices that are based on the idea of subordination of women and men.
(2) The mechanisms for gender equality in the state administration bodies and in the local self-government units determined by law perform coordination and give initiative for undertaking preventive measures in accordance with this law.

General Preventive Measures

## Article 34

The entities from Article 33 of this law undertake the following general preventive measures:
1) adopt a programme for planning and implementing preventive measures and activities in accordance with this law;

2) conduct campaigns for recognising the consequences of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence;
3) establish a system for regular publication of information on safety measures, advice and other useful information for prevention of violence and
4) mutually cooperate in the promotion and prevention of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence.

Министерство за труд и социјална политика

## Член 36

Министерството за труд и социјална политика покрај општите превентивни мерки од членот 34 од овој закон ги презема и следниве посебни превентивни мерки:
1)	спроведува програми за ненасилно разрешување на конфликти, почитување на различностите, промовирање на родовата еднаквост и елиминирање на стереотипите за родовите улоги базирани на културата, обичаите, верата, традициите и другите практики кои се засноваат на идејата за подреденост на жените и мажите во установите за згрижување и воспитание на деца од предучилишна возраст согласно со Законот за заштита на децата;
2)	обезбедува мерки за вклучување на жените жртви на родово-базирано насилство и жртвите на семејното насилство во активни мерки за вработување како и нивно вработување и
3)	спроведува кампањи или програми за подигнување на свеста и разбирањето на општата јавност за препознавање и последиците од насилството врз жените и семејното насилство.

Медиуми

## Член 37

Медиумите основани согласно со Законот за медиуми ги применуваат општите превентивни мерки од членот 34 точки 2), 3) и 4) од овој закон, во согласност со своите можности и независна и самостојна уредувачка политика, а ги преземаат и следниве посебни превентивни мерки:
1)	при креирањето и емитувањето информативни и едукативни програми водат сметка за подигање на свеста кај општата јавност за сите форми на родово-базирано насилство врз жени и семејно насилство, промовирање на родовата еднаквост и елиминирање на стереотипите за родовите улоги и
2)	самостојно или преку професионалните здруженија на новинари и медиумските работници воспоставуваат соработка со здруженијата за јакнење на своите капацитети за професионално известување за прашањата поврзани со насилство врз жени и семејно насилство.

Верски заедници

## Член 38

Црквите, верските заедници и религиозните групи се должни да се воздржат од изјави, соопштенија или објави со кои се оправдува родово-базираното насилство врз жените и семејното насилство како резултат на религија, култура, традиција или обичај.
Третман на сторители на семејно насилство

## Член 39

Психосоцијален третман на сторители на семејно насилство се обезбедува во советувалиште за сторители на насилство согласно со Законот за социјалната заштита и прописите од областа на здравствената заштита.

Пријавување од граѓанин

## Член 40

(1)	Секое физичко лице кое има сознание за постоење на родово-базирано насилство врз жени и семејно насилство е должен да пријави до полициска станица, центар за социјална работа, јавно обвинителство, здружение или С.О.С. линија.
(2)	Надлежните институции од ставот (1) на овој член се должни да постапат и по анонимна пријава.

(2)	Секое одговорно и раководно лице во правно лице е должно да пријави сознание за постоење на родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејно насилство до полициска станица или центар за социјална работа.
(3)	Секое одговорно и раководно лице во правно лице кога има сознание за постоење на родово-базирано насилство врз жените и семејно насилство, со кое се предизвикува непосредна опасност по животот и телото е должно да пријави до јавно обвинителство.

## Член 42

## Член 43

(2)	Придружникот може да биде кое било возрасно лице, освен лицето кое е сторител на родово-базирано насилство и/или семејно насилство во постапката.

(4)	Службеното лице кое ја спроведува постапката, нема да дозволи придружникот да ја придружува жртвата, во случај кога не ги исполнува условите од ставот (2) на овој член како и доколку процени дека придружникот не може да даде поддршка на жртвата од ставот (3) на овој член, поради роднински односи или други односи со жртвата или сторителот на насилство врз жените и/или семејното насилство.

Ministry of Labour and Social Policy

## Article 36

The Ministry of Labour and Social Policy, in addition to the general preventive measures from Article 34 of this law, shall undertake the following special preventive measures:
1) implements programs for non-violent conflict resolution, respect for differences, promotion of gender equality and elimination of stereotypes about gender roles based on culture, customs, religion, traditions and other practices that are based on the idea of subordination of women and men in institutions for care and upbringing of children of preschool age in accordance with the Law on Child Protection;
2) provides measures for inclusion of women victims of gender-based violence and victims of domestic violence in active employment measures as well as their employment and
3) implements campaigns or programs for raising awareness and understanding of the general public for recognition and consequences of violence against women and domestic violence.

Media

## Article 37

Media established in accordance with the Law on Media shall apply the general preventive measures from Article 34 points 2), 3) and 4) of this law, in accordance with their capacities and independent and autonomous editorial policy, and shall undertake the following special preventive measures:
1) when creating and broadcasting informative and educational programs, take into account raising awareness among the general public of all forms of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, promotion of gender equality and elimination of stereotypes about gender roles and
2) independently or through professional associations of journalists and media workers establish cooperation with associations for strengthening their capacities for professional reporting on issues related to violence against women and domestic violence.

Religious communities

## Article 38

Churches, religious communities and religious groups are obliged to refrain from statements, announcements or publications that justify gender-based violence against women and domestic violence as a result of religion, culture, tradition or custom.
Treatment of perpetrators of domestic violence

## Article 39

Psychosocial treatment of perpetrators of domestic violence is provided in a counselling centre for perpetrators of violence in accordance with the Law on Social Protection and regulations in the field of health protection.

VI. PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE AND VICTIMS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE

Reporting by a citizen

## Article 40

(1) Every natural person who has knowledge of the existence of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence is obliged to report to a police station, centre for social work, public prosecutor's office, association or S.O.S. line.
(2) The competent institutions from paragraph (1) of this article are obliged to act also on an anonymous report.

Reporting by officials

## Article 41

(1) The responsible person and the managing person from the institution that performs activities in the field of social and child protection, employment, internal affairs, health and education, are obliged to report knowledge of the existence of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence to a police station or centre for social work.

(2) Every responsible and managing person in a legal entity is obliged to report knowledge of the existence of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence to a police station or centre for social work.
(3) Every responsible and managing person in a legal entity when having knowledge of the existence of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, which causes immediate danger to life and body, is obliged to report to the public prosecutor's office.

## Article 42

(1) Information about the victim or the perpetrator of violence, on the basis of which the victim or members of her family can be identified, must not be publicly disclosed, unless the victim consents to it.
(2) Institutions, parents, guardians, carers or adoptive parents are obliged to protect the child from exposure to the public.

Accompanying person

## Article 43

(1) The victim has the right to choose a person who will accompany her during the procedure before the competent authority.
(2) The accompanying person may be any adult person, except the person who is a perpetrator of gender-based violence and/or domestic violence in the procedure.
(3) The accompanying person assists the victim in protecting her interest and provides support in procedures before officials and institutions and helps to find a solution for her case and provides support to the victim.
(4) The official conducting the procedure shall not allow the accompanying person to accompany the victim, in case when he/she does not meet the conditions from paragraph (2) of this article as well as if he/she assesses that the accompanying person cannot provide support to the victim from paragraph (3) of this article, due to kinship relations or other relations with the victim or the perpetrator of violence against women and/or domestic violence.
(5) Children and persons with limited or revoked legal capacity in procedures before competent institutions are accompanied by the parent or guardian, except the parent or guardian who is a perpetrator of violence against women and/or domestic violence.
VII. MEASURES FOR PROTECTION OF VICTIMS

Measures for protection from revictimization

## Article 44

The competent institutions from Article 40 paragraph (1) of this law are obliged to treat victims in a manner that will protect them additionally from victimization or revictimization, through undertaking the following measures, in accordance with their competences:
1) protection of the identity and personal data of the victim;
2) taking a statement at the place of reporting;
3) taking the statement of the victim in a police station or public prosecutor's office using video and audio recording which is used as evidence in the procedure with prior consent of the victim;
4) conversation in special premises adapted for conversation with victims;
5) limitation of confrontation with the reported person;
6) limitation of giving a statement to a maximum of two times during the procedure for protection from violence and

7) other measures that will protect the integrity of the victim.

## Article 45

(1) The Centre for Social Work is obliged to initiate proceedings immediately, and no later than within 12 hours of receiving information that gender-based violence against a woman or domestic violence has been committed, and to undertake measures for the protection of the victim, in accordance with the risk assessment.
(2) The Centre for Social Work initiates proceedings upon receiving information that gender-based violence against a woman or domestic violence has been committed, ex officio, at the request of the victim, upon a report from a citizen, official, institution or association.
(3) The Centre for Social Work in cases where the victim is a child or a person who is unable to care for themselves or a person with limited or revoked legal capacity, undertakes protection measures, regardless of whether there is consent from the parent or guardian.

## Article 46

The Centre for Social Work undertakes the following measures for the protection of victims:
1) provides temporary care;
2) ensures that the victim receives necessary medical assistance and, if necessary, accompanies them to the nearest health institution;
3) ensures that the victim exercises the right to social and health protection in accordance with the law;
4) provides appropriate psycho-social intervention and treatment;
5) ensures that the victim receives psycho-social treatment in a counselling centre from professional persons in the centre for social work, association, counselling centre for women victims of violence and other victims of domestic violence;
6) provides assistance to the family for regular schooling of the child;
7) provides legal assistance and representation;
8) refers the victim to the relevant state and other bodies competent for economic empowerment of the victim and their active inclusion in the labour market, through the competent employment centre, and
9) in case of high risk and undertaking of urgent protection measures, as well as when the victim uses temporary accommodation services, and no later than within 12 hours of receiving the report, issues a decision on temporary entrustment of care and upbringing of children to the parent victim.

## Article 47

(1) The Centre for Social Work when the victim is a child or a person who is unable to care for themselves or a person whose legal capacity has been limited or revoked, in addition to the measures from Article 46 of this law, also undertakes measures in accordance with the Family Law relating to the regulation of relations between parents and children, supervision over the exercise of parental rights and guardianship, and in accordance with the Juvenile Justice Law.
(2) In proceedings for entrusting the child to one of the parents, the centre for social work takes into account the best interests of the child, in a manner that will ensure that it does not endanger the rights and safety of the victim and/or the children.

(3) The Centre for Social Work may temporarily restrict or prohibit personal relations and direct contacts of the child with the parent with whom they do not live together, in case this is in the best interests of the child, while the risk and consequences of the committed violence persist.

## Article 48

(1) The Centre for Social Work whenever it has information that gender-based violence has been committed by a person who possesses a firearm immediately notifies the Ministry of Internal Affairs, and no later than within 24 hours submits a written notification.
(2) The Centre for Social Work whenever it has information that violence has been committed by a person who has access to and handles an official firearm, immediately, and no later than within 24 hours, submits a written notification to the institution or legal entity in which the person is employed and notifies the Ministry of Internal Affairs thereof.

## Article 49

(1) A police officer whenever there is a report of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, and in order to remove immediate and serious danger to the life and physical and psychological integrity of the victim and members of their family, is obliged to go to the scene of the incident and to prepare a police report immediately, and no later than within 12 hours of the intervention at the incident.
(2) The police officer in cases of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, when undertaking police work and applying police powers, operational-technical and preventive measures established by the Law on Police, always makes an assessment of the risk of serious danger to the life and physical and psychological integrity of the victim and members of their family and the risk of repetition of violence, with the aim of protecting the victim, through appropriate risk management.
(3) The police officer ensures that the victim immediately receives appropriate health protection from Article 51 of this law.
(4) The police officer when acting pursuant to paragraph (1) of this article, temporarily seizes the weapon from the perpetrator and initiates proceedings provided by law for revocation of the weapon permit, the collector's weapon permit or the weapon carrying permit.
(5) The police officer at the request of the victim accompanies them to the victim's residence to take personal belongings that are necessary for daily life, and if this is prevented by the perpetrator or other persons living in the same residence, in cooperation with the competent public prosecutor and an order issued by the court, takes the victim's personal belongings.
(6) In case of immediate and serious danger to the life and physical and psychological integrity of the victim and members of their family, the police officer is obliged immediately, and no later than within 12 hours of the intervention at the incident, to notify the competent public prosecutor.
(7) The police officer is obliged within the time limit established in paragraph (1) of this article to submit to the competent court a proposal for imposing an urgent protection measure - removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home, and a police report prepared by the police officer.

(8) The police officer is obliged within the time limit established in paragraph (1) of this article to notify the competent centre for social work in order to undertake urgent measures for the protection of the victim.

## Article 51

(1) The health institution and health workers are obliged to immediately take measures to protect the victim, namely:
- examination of injuries and provision of medical treatment,
- documentation of injuries and collection of evidence for the existence of harm to physical and psychological integrity,
- issuance of medical documentation for the established injury that clearly and comprehensibly describes the type and extent of the injuries,
- informing victims of their rights, the protection procedure and available assistance and support services, and
- taking other measures to protect victims in accordance with the needs of the victims.
(2) For the measures from paragraph (1) of this article, victims are exempt from payment of costs.
(3) The measures for health protection of women victims of violence and victims of family violence from paragraph (1) of this article are provided through an annual program adopted by the Minister of Health.

Associations

## Article 52

(1) An association may take protection measures from Article 46 points 1), 2), 4), 5), 7) and
8) of this law, independently or in cooperation with the competent social work center.
(2) The association is obliged for the protection measures taken from paragraph (1) of this article, within 24 hours of taking the measures, to notify the social work center competent according to the place of residence of the victim.

Local self-government units

## Article 53

(1) Local self-government units are obliged to provide funds in the budget for financial support to victims of gender-based violence and family violence.
(2) The scope, coverage, amount and duration of financial support for victims is regulated by each local self-government unit in accordance with law.

Educational institutions

## Article 54

Educational institutions in the territory of local self-government units are obliged to provide urgent enrollment of child victims of violence in schools or kindergartens in their territory without requiring consent from both parents.

Multisectoral expert team

## Article 55

(1) In cases where there is knowledge of endangerment of the life and health of women victims of gender-based violence and victims of family violence and family members, a safety plan for assistance is prepared by a multisectoral expert team.
(2) The competent social work center, according to the residence or domicile of the victim, forms a multisectoral expert team from paragraph (1) of this article which is composed of professional persons from the social work center, competent police station and health institution, with the aim of taking coordinated activities in providing assistance to the victim in accordance with her needs.
(3) In the work of the multisectoral expert team from paragraph (2) of this article, representatives of associations participate, who may propose and implement measures and activities from the safety plan for assistance to the victim.
(4) In case there is knowledge of endangerment of the life and health of a child, the multisectoral expert team in the safety plan for assistance to the parent provides for measures and activities that should be implemented for assistance to the child.

## Article 56

All measures and services for victims of gender-based and family violence provided by this law, which are available to citizens of the Republic of North Macedonia, are equally available to refugees, asylum seekers, stateless persons and persons without documents or personal identification, regardless of the procedure for regulating their status.

VIII. URGENT AND TEMPORARY PROTECTION MEASURES

Urgent measure

## Article 57

(1) In order to remove immediate and serious danger to the life and physical and psychological integrity of the victim and members of her family, an urgent protection measure is imposed, namely removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home, on the proposal of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, without the consent of the victim.
(2) The proposal for imposing an urgent protection measure is submitted by the Ministry of Internal Affairs to the competent court after the risk assessment made under Article 50 paragraph (2) of this law and the police report from Article 49 paragraph (7) of this law.
(3) The urgent protection measure from paragraph (1) of this article is imposed for a duration of at least ten and at most up to 30 days.

Temporary protection measures

## Article 58

(1) In order to stop the violence, remove the consequences of the committed violence and take effective measures towards the perpetrator of violence, in order to eliminate the causes for repeated commission of violence, the court may impose the following temporary protection measures on the perpetrator of gender-based violence against women and victims of family violence:
1) prohibition to threaten to commit violence;
2) prohibition to mistreat, harass, telephone, contact or otherwise directly or indirectly communicate with the victim;
3) prohibition to approach at a distance less than 100 meters from the residence, school, workplace or specific place regularly visited by the victim;
4) removal from the home regardless of ownership for a duration of ten to 30 days;
5) prohibition to possess firearms or other weapons or to have them confiscated;
6) obligation to return items necessary to satisfy the daily needs of the victim and family;
7) mandatory legal maintenance of the family;
8) mandatory attendance at a counseling center for perpetrators of violence against women or family violence;
9) mandatory treatment of the perpetrator if he uses alcohol, drugs and other psychotropic substances or has a mental illness;
10) the perpetrator must compensate for medical and other costs arising from the violence, and
11) any other measure that the court deems necessary to ensure the safety and well-being of the victim and other family members.
(2) In proceedings in which the court decides on temporary protection measures, the provisions of the Law on Civil Procedure apply, unless otherwise regulated by this law.

## Article 59

(1) The Ministry of Internal Affairs is obliged to submit a proposal for imposing an urgent protection measure from Article 57 of this law to the competent court in order to remove immediate and serious danger to the life and physical and psychological integrity of the victim and members of her family.

(2) The victim may submit a proposal for imposing a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law to the competent court directly or through the social work center at her request.
(3) The social work center may submit a proposal for imposing a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law to the competent court with the consent of the victim.
(4) A parent or guardian may submit a proposal for imposing a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, on behalf of a minor child and a person with limited or revoked legal capacity, as well as for a person over whom parental rights have been extended.
(5) The social work center is obliged to submit to the court a proposal for imposing a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, on behalf of children and legally incapacitated persons whenever the parent, guardian or legal representative fails to do so and without their consent.
(6) The social work center in the proposal to the court for imposing a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, for a child may propose that the temporary protection measure also apply to the parent with whom the child lives, in cases where this is required by the interests of the child for his protection and safety.

## Article 60

The social work center with the proposal for imposing a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, submits findings and opinion of the expert team in which it also provides a proposal for imposing a temporary measure/s depending on the established needs for protection of the victim.

## Article 61

A proposal for imposing a temporary measure may be submitted regardless of whether criminal proceedings are being conducted.

## Article 62

(1) The temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law may last at least three months and at most up to one year.
(2) If violence continues after the expiration of the period for which the temporary protection measure was imposed within the period of one year from paragraph (1) of this article, the victim or the social work center may submit a request for extension of the measure(s).
(3) After the expiration of one year from the imposed temporary protection measure from paragraph (1) of this article, in case violence against women and domestic violence occurs again, the victim or the social work center submits a new proposal to the court.

## Article 63

(1) The victim or the social work center may submit a proposal to the competent court for revocation of the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law even before the expiration of the period for which the measure was imposed, if it is assessed that it has achieved the purpose for which it was imposed.
(2) The victim or the social work center may submit a proposal for modification of the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law or for its extension, if the imposed measure has not provided adequate protection to the victim or changed circumstances have occurred.

Imposition of temporary protection measures

## Article 64

In proceedings in which the court decides on temporary protection measures, the provisions of the Law on Civil Procedure apply, unless otherwise determined by this law.

## Article 65

(1) In proceedings for imposition of temporary protection measures for gender-based violence against women and domestic violence, a single judge decides.
(2) In the proceedings from paragraph (1) of this article of this law, the public is excluded from the hearing.
(3) By way of exception from paragraph (2) of this article, the judge may allow scientific and public workers who deal with the problems of marriage and family, as well as persons proposed by the parties, to attend the hearing.

## Article 66

(1) The court, immediately and at the latest within 24 hours after receipt of the proposal from the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the police report, without holding a hearing, shall decide on the imposition of an urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law.
(2) The court shall act immediately on the proposal of the victim or the social work center for imposition of a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, and at the latest within seven days from the day of receipt of the request shall issue a decision.
(3) The court within 24 hours without holding a hearing shall decide on the imposition of an urgent protection measure from Article 57 of this law, when there is reasonable suspicion of serious danger to the life and health of the victim or a family member, based on an expert finding and opinion of the social work center.

## Article 67

(1) The hearing is held in the presence of the victim, the opponent (the perpetrator of gender-based violence against women and domestic violence) and a representative from the social work center, when it is the submitter of the proposal for imposition of a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law.
(2) When the victim is a child and/or a person with limited or revoked legal capacity, at the hearing they are represented by the parent who is not an opponent in the proceedings or by the guardian.
(3) The summons for holding the hearing is delivered by the court to the opponent within two days from the day of receipt of the proposal.
(4) At the court's assessment, other persons may also be summoned to the hearing.
(5) By way of exception from paragraph (1) of this article, when there is reasonable suspicion of serious danger to the life and health of the victim or a family member, the court may impose an urgent protection measure from Article 57 of this law, in the absence of the opponent and based on an expert finding and opinion of the social work center, if other evidence has not been obtained.

## Article 68

The court, upon proposal of the social work center, or of the woman victim of gender-based violence and the victim of domestic violence, may extend, revoke or modify the imposed temporary protection measure(s) from Article 58 of this law.

## Article 69

In the decision by which the urgent protection measure from Article 57 of this law and the temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law are imposed, the court shall oblige the perpetrator of gender-based violence against women and the victim of domestic violence to respect the court decision.

## Article 70

(1) The decision on the imposed urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law, the court within six hours from issuing the decision delivers to the competent police station at the place of enforcement, which immediately and at the latest within 12 hours after receipt of the decision, delivers it to the perpetrator of gender-based violence against women and other victim of domestic violence.
(2) In case the delivery cannot be carried out within the period from paragraph (1) of this article, the court, upon receiving notification from the Ministry of Internal Affairs, publishes the decision on the bulletin board of the court, whereby the delivery is considered proper.
(3) The Ministry of Internal Affairs is obliged to remove the perpetrator from the home within two hours, counted from the moment when the decision on the imposed urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law is served, in case they do not want to leave the home voluntarily.

## Article 71

(1) A copy of the decision on the urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law, the court delivers to the public prosecutor and the social work center.
(2) A copy of the decision on imposition of a temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, the court delivers to the parties, the social work center and the institution competent for enforcement of the temporary protection measure.

## Article 72

(1) An appeal against a decision of the basic court on an imposed urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law or temporary protection measure(s) from Article 58 of this law may be filed within three days from the day of receipt of the decision.
(2) An appeal filed against the court's decision does not delay its enforcement.

Enforcement of urgent and temporary protection measures

## Article 73

(1) The Ministry of Internal Affairs enforces the imposed urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law and the temporary protection measures from Article 58 paragraph (1) points 1), 2), 3), 4) and
5) of this law, the Ministry of Health enforces the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 paragraph (1) point 9) of this law, the counseling center for perpetrators of domestic violence enforces the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 paragraph
(1) point 8) of this law, and the enforcement of the imposed temporary protection measures from Article 58 paragraph (1) points 6), 7), 10) and 11) of this law is carried out in accordance with the law.
(2) The counseling center for perpetrators of gender-based violence and domestic violence enforces a court decision for protective supervision in the part of the determined obligation for the convicted person for a criminal offense of gender-based violence and domestic violence to

attend a program for working with convicts for criminal offenses committed in the commission of gender-based violence and domestic violence and notifies the court of the fulfillment of the obligation.

(1) The manner of execution of the imposed urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law and the temporary protection measures from Article 58 paragraph (1) points 1), 2), 3), 4) and 5) of this law shall be prescribed by the Minister of Internal Affairs.

(1) The social work centre shall monitor the execution of the imposed temporary protection measure/s from Article 58 of this law.
(2) For the monitoring of the temporary protection measures from paragraph (1) of this article, the social work centre shall cooperate with citizens, legal entities, institutions and associations.
(3) The social work centre shall inform the court of the course and effects of the execution of the imposed temporary protection measure/s from paragraph (1) of this article.

## Article 76

(1) The court may request a report from the Ministry of Internal Affairs on the manner of implementation and compliance with the imposed urgent protection measure of removal of the perpetrator from the home and prohibition of approaching the home from Article 57 of this law.
(2) The court may request a report from the social work centre on the implementation of the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law during the monitoring period.

## Article 77

The victim shall inform the social work centre of non-compliance with and/or violation of the imposed temporary protection measure/s from Article 58 of this law in proceedings upon her request.

## Article 78

(1) The Ministry of Internal Affairs is obliged to immediately inform the court of non-compliance with or violation of the imposed urgent protection measure from Article 57 of this law.
(2) The social work centre is obliged to immediately inform the court of non-compliance with or violation of the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law.

## Article 79

The Ministry of Internal Affairs, when an urgent protection measure from Article 57 of this law is violated in the part concerning the prohibition of approaching the home, shall submit a proposal to the public prosecutor for the determination of precautionary measures, in accordance with the Law on Criminal Procedure.

## Article 80

(1) The social work centre is obliged to file a criminal complaint against the perpetrator for non-compliance with the court decision on the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law.
(2) The social work centre is obliged to file a criminal complaint against the perpetrator for non-compliance with the court decision on the imposed temporary protection measure from Article 58 of this law, whenever the violence is committed against a child or in the presence of a child.
(3) The public prosecutor is obliged to inform the social work centre in writing of the initiated criminal proceedings, following the criminal complaint from paragraphs (1) and (2) of this article.

## Article 81

The manner of implementation and the manner of monitoring of the imposed temporary protection measures from Article 58 of this law shall be prescribed by the Minister of Labour and Social Policy.

IX. JUDICIAL PROTECTION

Judicial protection of victims

## Article 82

(1) Victims have the right to judicial protection, in civil proceedings and criminal proceedings before locally and materially competent courts.
(2) Victims have the right to special measures of procedural protection in accordance with the Law on Criminal Procedure and the Law on Justice for Children.

Claim for establishing liability for failure to act with due diligence

## Article 83

(1) The victim has the right to file a claim before a civil court for establishing liability for failure to act with due diligence of the subjects from Article 4 of this law.
(2) In the claim from paragraph (1) of this article, the following requests may be made:
1) to establish the liability of the defendant for failure to act with due diligence established by this law;
2) to award compensation for damages to the victim due to failure to act with due diligence by the defendant and
3) to oblige the defendant to take actions for the protection of the victim in accordance with the provisions and deadlines established by this law.
(3) In the proceedings, the provisions of the Law on Civil Procedure shall apply accordingly, unless otherwise regulated by this law.

Local jurisdiction

## Article 84

In all civil proceedings for the protection of victims of gender-based violence and domestic violence, locally competent, in addition to the court with general local jurisdiction, is also the court in whose area is the residence, registered temporary residence of the plaintiff or the seat of the accommodation centre where the victim is accommodated.

Burden of proof

## Article 85

The plaintiff who claims that in accordance with the provisions of this law the principle of due diligence has been violated is obliged to present the facts that make the claim probable and then the burden of proof passes to the defendant to prove that he acted with due diligence.

Amicable settlement of disputes

## Article 86

In proceedings relating to the protection of victims, the court may not refer to mandatory amicable settlement of the dispute.

Compensation of victims

## Article 87

(1) Victims have the right to compensation for material and non-material damage in accordance with the law.
(2) A victim who cannot collect his property claim awarded by a final court judgment from the perpetrator, may request that it be paid from a state fund in accordance with the law.
(3) Victims are exempt from payment of all costs of proceedings for compensation for damages until the final collection of the property claim in accordance with the law.

X. SERVICES FOR WOMEN VICTIMS OF GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE AND DOMESTIC VIOLENCE

General services for victims

## Article 88

(1) Women victims of gender-based violence and victims of domestic violence have access to health and social services.
(2) Officials in institutions that provide health and social services are obliged to give them support and assistance and to refer them to other appropriate specialized service providers.

Specialized services for victims

## Article 89

(1) Specialized services for women victims of gender-based violence and domestic violence are services that respond to the specific needs of victims of different types of violence.
(2) The specialized services from paragraph (1) of this article are provided without compensation in a manner that protects the privacy, dignity and reputation of the victims.
(3) The specialized services from paragraph (1) of this article are available to all victims including their children regardless of the victim's willingness to testify in proceedings against the perpetrator.

(4) The specialized services from paragraph (1) of this article are financed from funds from the Budget of the Republic of North Macedonia, from the budgets of local self-government units and other sources of financing.

Information and referral services

## Article 90

(1) The information and referral service is provided through an S.O.S. line.
(2) The S.O.S. line provides 24-hour accurate, timely and confidential information on the protection of victims, available services and telephone counselling to women victims of violence and victims of domestic violence.
(3) The service from paragraph (1) of this article is provided by social service providers in accordance with the Law on Social Protection.

(1) The counselling service includes psycho-social support, counselling and treatment of women victims of gender-based violence, children victims of gender-based violence and victims of domestic violence.

Service for temporary accommodation

## Article 92

(1) The service for temporary accommodation provides care in a centre for temporary accommodation when there is knowledge of a real threat to the life and health of the victim or in the absence of other care resources for the following categories of persons:
1) women victims of gender-based violence and domestic violence and their children;
2) women victims of sexual violence and rape;
3) victims of trafficking in human beings and
4) victims of violence due to sexual orientation and gender identity.
(2) Emergency accommodation is provided in an acute situation of violence when there is a serious real threat to the life and health of the victim for a duration of 24 to 72 hours.
(3) In addition to care in the centre from paragraph (1) of this article, victims receive protection, psycho-social assistance and support, treatment for overcoming trauma, legal counselling, inclusion in active employment measures for the victim with the aim of inclusion in the labour market and achieving financial independence and other services depending on the needs of the victim in accordance with law.

Upon receipt of the misdemeanor payment order, the perpetrator is obliged to pay the fine imposed in the misdemeanor payment order within eight days from the day of receipt of the misdemeanor payment order.
(4) When a legal entity appears as the perpetrator of a misdemeanor, the record and the misdemeanor payment order are signed by the responsible person or a person authorized by them.
(5) The perpetrator who pays the fine within the period from paragraph (3) of this article will pay only half of the imposed fine, which right is instructed in the legal instruction.
(6) If the perpetrator does not pay the fine within the period from paragraph (3) of this article, the inspector shall submit a request for initiation of misdemeanor proceedings to the competent authority.
(7) In the settlement procedure, the fine in the misdemeanor payment order is imposed in a fixed amount prescribed by law, and if the fine is prescribed in a range, the minimum prescribed amount for the misdemeanor is imposed.
(8) In the procedure that will end with payment of a misdemeanor payment order, no costs of the procedure are paid.
(9) If the perpetrator does not agree to be issued a misdemeanor payment order, this shall be noted in the record of the established misdemeanor, and the inspector submits a request for initiation of misdemeanor proceedings before the competent court.

## Article 103

The determination of the amount of the fine for legal entities is carried out in accordance with the Law on Misdemeanors.

## Article 104

For the misdemeanors from Article 101 of this law, misdemeanor proceedings are conducted and misdemeanor sanctions are imposed by the competent court.

XIII. TRANSITIONAL AND FINAL PROVISIONS

## Article 105

The National Coordinating Body from Article 15 of this law shall be formed within three months from the day of entry into force of this law.

## Article 106

Proceedings initiated until the day of commencement of application of this law shall be completed according to the provisions of this law.

## Article 107

Laws that contain provisions relating to prevention and protection from violence against women and domestic violence shall be harmonized with this law within six months from the day of entry into force of this law.

## Article 108

The by-laws envisaged by this law shall be adopted within three months from the day of entry into force of this law.

## Article 109

On the day of commencement of application of this law, the Law on Prevention, Combating and Protection from Domestic Violence ("Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia" numbers 138/14, 33/15 and 150/15) ceases to be valid.

## Article 110

On the day of commencement of application of this law, the mandate of the president and members of the National Coordinating Body for Combating and Protection from Domestic Violence ceases.

## Article 111

The provisions of Article 20 point 2) and Article 87 paragraphs (2) and (3) of this law shall commence to be applied within two years from the day of entry into force of this law.

## Article 112

This law enters into force on the eighth day from the day of its publication in the "Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia", and shall commence to be applied three months from the day of entry into force of this law.
